summary: The 0.32.3 settlement capability observer is a separate manual protected workflow with contents/actions read only. It performs GET-only requests through a closed host/route/credential-role adapter, runs a guard step before exposing the dispatcher App ID/key, signs only an App JWT, reads /app and the repository installation twice around a main re-read, never mints an installation token and never mutates workflows, refs, policy or packages. Its report carries workflow-inventory and ruleset digests labelled by observing identity: the inventory digest joins settlement exactly, but the ruleset digest was observed with the job token and must be confirmed under the administrator identity before use in admission bytes. Permission ceilings are observations, not authority; settlementEligible stays false. Secret canaries must include JSON-escaped and per-line forms of multi-line keys. This is source only: the metadata run, any writer or policy setup, settlement, publication and public Wizard acceptance remain separate root-owned effects, and originalTransportOutcome stays Unknown.
title: Settlement capability observation is read-only metadata and not authority
